data.content:
The day with the highest number of runs created before 2026‑10‑28 UTC was **2026‑07‑12**, with **11 runs** created on that day.

```json
{
  "question": "On which day (UTC) were the most runs created before October 28, 2026, and how many runs were created that day?",
  "sql": "SELECT created_at::date AS day_utc, COUNT(*) AS run_count\nFROM runs\nWHERE created_at < '2026-10-28'::date\nGROUP BY day_utc\nORDER BY run_count DESC\nLIMIT 1;",
  "row_count": 1,
  "answer": "The day with the most runs was 2026-07-12, with 11 runs created."
}
```
